deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring Entur using YAML is being removed, but the stop {stop_id} could not be imported because Entur could not be reached.

Restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the `{domain}` sensor platform from configuration.yaml and add the stop through the UI.
